verdicts.title: Failed backup restore leaves the global DB connection pool permanently closed (app-wide outage until restart)
verdicts.reason: Code-truth confirmed: line 440 closes current_pool unconditionally before any reversible work. backup::restore_backup's Err propagates via `?` at line 446-449, returning early — replace_pool (line 512) is only reached inside the Ok(new_pool) success branch of the retry loop. The retry-exhaustion path (526-529) also returns Err with no call to replace_pool. No branch in the function re-opens/restores db's pool on failure, so a closed pool persists app-wide until process restart.
